Name: Core Fanbase
Game logic: The regulars. Every 3 points cancel 1 Risk while they're in chat.

Name: Staff
Game logic: The people the stream pays. Each point gives every Staff viewer a 10% chance to have their Cash cost waived each time they're scored.

Name: Content
Game logic: Each point gives every viewer outside the Core Fanbase a 10% chance to score twice when the stream ends.

Name: Techspertise
Game logic: If the server goes down (chat over the Sub Cap), the stream may still score: 20% / 40% / 50% at 1 / 2 / 3 points.

Name: Finance Bros
Game logic: Each point gives every viewer a 10% chance to score their Cash reward twice.

Name: Trolls
Game logic: If the stream gets deplatformed (Risk over the limit), each point pays 1 random Clout or Cash. This doesn't apply if you end the stream yourself or the server goes down.

Name: Doomsdayers
Game logic: Multiplayer only. After your successful stream, each point gives every viewer in your rivals' next stream a 4% chance to score nothing.

Name: Boomer
Game logic: Old money, old opinions. When the stream is scored, each point gives +2 Cash and -1 Clout (fixed, once per stream).

Name: Millennial
Game logic: Very online, slightly broke. When the stream is scored, each point gives +2 Clout and -1 Cash (fixed, once per stream).

Name: Zoomer
Game logic: Chaotic. When the stream is scored, two separate rolls, each with a 20% chance per point: +6 Clout, and -3 Cash.

Name: Armchair Activists
Game logic: All talk. Each point gives every Armchair Activist in chat a 10% chance to score nothing when the stream ends. Other viewers aren't affected.

Name: Clout
Game logic: Everyone wants a piece. Each viewer outside the Core Fanbase has a 10% chance per point to bring +1 Clout more, every time they score.

Name: Memetics Division
Game logic: Reposted forever. Each point gives a 1% chance that the whole stream scores a second time: every viewer and every community reward, all rolled again.

Name: Bots
Game logic: Multiplayer only. When your stream is scored, each Bots viewer in chat has a 10% chance per point to send a Bot into the next player's next stream. A Bot takes a space in chat and earns nothing. At most 6 Bots can wait for one player.
